question: Why was the National Anti-Corruption Commission established?

points.claim: The National Anti-Corruption Commission was established to give the Commonwealth a standing body able to investigate serious or systemic corruption, after years of debate about gaps in federal integrity oversight.
Jordan Sample told the Senate the commission would investigate "serious or systemic corruption across the Commonwealth public sector", including ministers and their staff.
points.quote: serious or systemic corruption across the Commonwealth public sector

points.claim: The Albanese Government had promised it at the 2022 election, and the commission began operating on 1 July 2023.

77777777777777777777777777777777/t/body/.text: This commission will have the power to investigate serious or systemic corruption across the Commonwealth public sector, including ministers and their staff.
